shortDescription: TORONTO, Nov. 16, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Sunday Lake Gold Corp. (TSX: SNDY, OTCQX: SLGCF) (“Sunday Lake Gold” or the “Company”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Sylvain Goyette, P.Eng., MBA, as Vice President, Project Development and Operations effective November 16, 2026.Mr. Goyette is…

children: ”) is pleased to announce the appointment of Sylvain Goyette, P.Eng., MBA, as Vice President, Project Development and Operations effective November 16, 2026.

Mr. Goyette is a seasoned mining executive with more than 25 years of international experience spanning mine development, engineering, operations, project management and corporate leadership. He brings extensive technical and operational expertise gained through senior positions with leading global mining companies, including Wyloo, Glencore, Xstrata and Noranda.

Most recently, Mr. Goyette served as Vice President, Projects at Wyloo, where he held a senior leadership role from 2023 to 2026. Prior to joining Wyloo, he spent more than a decade with Glencore in progressively senior positions across North America, Africa and the South Pacific, including serving as President of Glencore's New Caledonia operations from 2014 to 2018.

Mr. Goyette holds a Bachelor of Science in Mining Engineering from McGill University and a Master of Business Administration from HEC Montréal. He also holds a First Class Mine Manager's Certificate of Competency from Western Australia and has served on several industry and corporate boards.

“We are very pleased to welcome Sylvain to the Sunday Lake Gold team. He brings an exceptional combination of technical expertise, operational leadership and project development experience,” commented Brian Penny, Sunday Lake Gold CEO. “As we continue to advance our flagship Fenelon Gold Project toward a Pre-Feasibility Study (“

”), strengthening our project development capabilities is a key priority. Establishing a strong technical and operational foundation at this stage is critical to positioning Fenelon for long-term success. Sylvain’s extensive experience and proven leadership will be instrumental in guiding the project through the PFS process and laying the groundwork for future development.”

Sunday Lake Gold Corp. is focused on creating value through the exploration and sustainable development of gold projects in Quebec’s Abitibi region while respecting the environment and communities where it operates. The Company holds a contiguous mineral property position totaling 598 km2 that extends approximately 82 km along the Detour-Fenelon gold trend. The property is host to the Company’s flagship PEA-stage Fenelon Gold Project, and its earlier exploration stage Martiniere Gold Project, as well as numerous greenfield gold projects.
